title: SkyMine-FarmFixer
description:
A farm-mechanic patch for the skymine.fun server with WorldGuard integration.

On economy servers, auto-farms are a constant source of imbalance: players find exploits in growth and drop mechanics. The plugin closes such loopholes surgically — only within WorldGuard regions, leaving vanilla mechanics untouched outside their borders. The config updates via /farmfix reload without a restart.
